truthAudit.Summary: Truth audit of Run 2 against 20 ground-truth vulnerabilities. Run 2 found 9 of 20 true vulnerabilities (7 fully, 1 partially, 1 partially with CWE error). Run 2 missed 11 true vulnerabilities including critical issues (Integer Underflow SC-V3-016, Use-After-Free escalation SC-V3-003 severity, Logic Bomb SC-V3-007). Run 2 had 3 findings not in ground truth: AdminConsole command injection (real but distinct from SC-V3-004), safe_string_copy off-by-one (real but not in ground truth), and data race in get() only (partial for SC-V3-006). Severity misclassifications found for SC-V3-001, SC-V3-005, SC-V3-009, SC-V3-010. CWE misclassification for SC-V3-011 (CWE-330 vs CWE-338).

Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified format string injection in log_debug_message with exact evidence quote and correct CWE-134. Severity was rated High instead of Critical (overclaim of lower severity).
No finding about integer overflow in factorial computation (fact() function using long long result *= i which overflows for large inputs).
Run 2 correctly identified use-after-free in stage_deferred_history_flush with accurate evidence and correct CWE-416. Severity rated High instead of Critical.
Run 2 correctly identified command injection in ConfigLoader::validate_config with correct CWE-78. Severity rated High instead of Critical.
Run 2 correctly identified stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression with correct CWE-120. Severity overrated as Critical instead of High.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: long long get() const { return value_; }
Items.Notes: Run 2 found data race in get() but missed the primary race in increment() where old_value = value_ is read BEFORE lock_guard, then written after. Only partial coverage of SC-V3-006.
No finding about logic bomb where login_attempts_ > 5 combined with EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE string grants authentication bypass.
No finding about path traversal via config_dir_ + filename in load_config() allowing directory escape.
Run 2 correctly identified heap overflow in ExpressionParser::parse with correct CWE-120. Severity underrated as High instead of Critical.
Run 2 correctly identified hardcoded admin credentials with correct CWE-798. Severity underrated as Medium instead of High.

Run 2 found weak PRNG issue but misclassified as CWE-330 instead of correct CWE-338 (Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator). Also used mt19937 which is specifically the weak PRNG concern.
No finding about thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time in log_debug_message modified via localtime() without synchronization.
No finding about insecure temp file handling in append_override_audit_event() using TEMP/TMPDIR env vars with system() command injection risk.
No finding about persistent authentication state (authenticated_, login_attempts_, session_token_) surviving across sessions without proper invalidation.
No finding about unhandled std::stod(tokens[3]) exception in handle_variable_command which can crash on malformed input.
No finding about integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate where previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES can underflow if size is close to previous_size, leading to incorrect fragment.size.
No finding about unbounded recursion in parse_factor -> parse_expression -> parse_term -> parse_factor cycle with nested parentheses causing stack overflow.
No finding about data race in result_cache_ in evaluate_cached() where cache_mutex_ protects reads but thread_pool_->enqueue can trigger concurrent modifications.
No finding about TOCTOU race in load_config() between filesystem::exists() check and ifstream open with sleep_for in between.
No finding about integer division by zero in calculate_route_score() where 100 / token_length crashes if input is empty string.
